description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about compensation for disruptions.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about compensation for disruptions, last updated between 2026-07-06 and 2026-08-18. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Phase 2 (Aug 12): $200 per travelling passenger.". Keep it about its own topic; do not connect it to any other policy. Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
